pre_open_validation_history.reason: placebo p02 exceeded the preregistered 0.10 token tolerance and the name scanner used substring rather than token matching
pre_open_validation_history.resolution: token-match p02 and correct the assurance scanner, then refreeze all affected hashes before opening results

analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: count of cases with verdict pathway_supported
analysis_plan.positive_control: persistence_on must score 1.0 for every case
analysis_plan.negative_control: persistence_off and placebo must score 0.0 for every case
analysis_plan.non_vacuous_control: positive and negative scores must differ for every case
analysis_plan.missing_or_mismatched_hash_behavior: fail before model execution and do not write evidence
analysis_plan.multiple_comparison_adjustment: not applicable: deterministic exact endpoints, no inferential p-values
analysis_plan.analysis_changes_after_results: forbidden for v1; any change requires a new version and new dataset

claim_policy.allowed: mechanism attribution at the frozen synthetic deterministic harness boundary
